comuneros-revolt-new-granada.description: A dramatic painted crowd of rural, mostly dark-skinned peasants marches up a stony mountain path under a stormy sky. A central man in a dark ragged poncho and wide-brimmed hat raises a long spear and holds a machete. Behind him, hundreds more carry pikes, machetes and a few muskets, with women in long skirts and straw hats. A colonial-style town with a church sits in the valley below. Era cues are pre-industrial: straw hats, ponchos, linen shirts, spears and muskets. No text, no frame, no blood.

inconfidencia-mineira-plot.description: A candlelit room with rough plank walls and shutters. Five or six men in dark 18th-century coats and waistcoats crowd around a wooden table covered in maps, folded letters, a quill, an inkwell and a pocket watch. A bearded older man in the centre leans over the map, and a younger man in a maroon coat gestures. Another man on the left seated at the table writes. The scribbled papers show no legible text. Painted oil style, filling the whole frame.

narino-prints-rights-of-man.description: A dark-haired man in a waistcoat and rolled white sleeves leans over a wooden screw press in a dim brick back room, lit by a small lantern. Crates, paper stacks and inkwells fill the room, and a stack of printed sheets sits at lower right with illegible painterly marks. No frame, border or signature, and nothing graphic.

gual-espana-conspiracy.description: An interior of a dim, wood-beamed room with a lit lantern on a table. Around the table sit several men of mixed complexions, some holding papers and a quill, with a few more standing behind them. At the left, uniformed soldiers in tricorn hats and white cross-belts with bayonets push through an open door, one raising a sabre. Through the open window at right, moonlit water shows sailing ships at anchor and distant hills. No visible text.

haitian-revolution-uprising-begins.description: A lone man in dark clothes stands on a rock in the centre, raising a blazing machete overhead. Around him a crowd of people in pale, worn clothing raise their arms, hold machetes and axes, and look up at him. Behind them, under a dark stormy sky, a wide plain burns with fires and smoke. Dark, painterly, oil-like style, full-bleed with no border.

toussaint-louverture-captured.description: A Black man in a dark bicorne hat and a grey coat with gold embroidery and epaulettes stands on a wet beach at night, with a sword at his side. Around him, soldiers in blue and white uniforms with red trim hold lanterns, and one grips his arm. Behind them a rowboat with sacks sits on the water, and a tall-masted sailing ship with a small flag rides offshore under a stormy sky with a moon. No visible text or frame; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

portuguese-court-reaches-brazil.description: A gilded rowing barge carries a group of people in formal 18th-to-early-19th-century court dress across a harbour toward a stone quay. A man in a dark cloak and bicorne hat sits near a woman in a yellow gown. Oarsmen in white shirts row. Behind them, several tall three-masted sailing ships with furled and billowing sails sit at anchor. A steep rocky peak rises on the left under a dramatic cloudy sky, and crowds with torches line the waterfront. The painting is an oil-style image with no visible frame or text.

grito-de-dolores.description: A white-haired man in a long black cassock stands on stone church steps under a bell tower at night, one fist raised. Below him a crowd holds burning torches, machetes, pitchforks and axes. A large bronze bell hangs in the open belfry, and a plastered building with an arched doorway sits to the right. No visible text, no frame edges; the painting fills the square.

bolivar-named-el-libertador.description: A man in a black military coat with gold epaulettes and gold braid rides a white horse through a sunlit colonial street, raising one hand in greeting. Balconies overhead hold people throwing flowers, and a crowd below holds candles and flowers. A soldier in a bicorne hat sits on a horse behind him, and the painting runs edge to edge with no visible text, frame, or gore.

san-martin-crosses-andes.description: A painting of a snowy mountain pass between dark, jagged peaks. A column of soldiers in dark coats and caps hauls a bronze cannon on wooden spoked wheels up the snow, with pack mules loaded with bundles on the left. A rider in a dark cloak sits on a dark horse on a rock ledge at upper right, looking down the trail. A stormy grey sky fills the top. No text, frame or border is visible.

battle-of-boyaca.description: A mounted officer in a dark cocked hat raises a sword on a rearing bay horse at the center of a stone arch bridge over a rushing stream. Dark-blue-coated infantry with red facings fire and advance from the left, while white-uniformed troops with red-and-white belts fight, stumble and fall on the right, with smoke and musket flashes through the mountain valley. A small tricolour flag is visible on the left, and a fallen soldier lies on the bridge with no visible blood. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no text or border.

bolivar-dies-santa-marta.description: A shaded colonial veranda with arched openings and a tiled floor. A hammock hangs between the pillars on the left, and through the arches there are palm trees and a stormy grey sea. On the right, a wooden chair holds a dark blue coat with red facings and a gold epaulette, with a sword laid across it and a folded paper beside it. No people are visible.

spain-recognizes-mexico.description: Two men in dark high-collared coats with gold trim sit at a gilded, ornate table in a dim, panelled room lit by a single candle. The man on the left, seen from behind, watches while the man on the right writes with a quill on a sheet of paper. Portraits hang on the walls, and an inkwell and a red sealing item sit on the table. No visible text, frame or wounds.

duarte-founds-la-trinitaria.description: A candlelit dark room with a wooden table, an open book, a small crucifix and a lit candle. A man in a dark suit with a white cravat stands centre, one hand raised, leading a group of about six young men in early-19th-century coats and cravats who press hands to their chests or clasp hands. A seated man at the table in the foreground has his hands folded. Shuttered window behind, no visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the image edge to edge.
